const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Recorded RoboWits collect_screws policy, using only camera and proprioception."""
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+SCREW_XY = (0.380, -0.206)
+CONTAINER_XY = (0.620, 0.000)
+VERTICAL_DOWN = [0.0, 2**-0.5, 2**-0.5, 0.0]  # tool +z points down; fingers close along world y
+
+
+def save_obs(obs, tag):
+    d = OUT / tag
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for camera, image in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(image).save(d / f"{camera}.png")
+    if getattr(obs, "last_depth", None):
+        for camera, depth in obs.last_depth.items():
+            np.save(d / f"{camera}_depth.npy", depth)
+    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+
+
+class Controller:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.robot = Robot()
+        self.calls = 0
+
+    def observation(self, tag):
+        obs = self.robot.get_obs(depth=True)
+        save_obs(obs, tag)
+        return obs
+
+    def move_right(self, xyz, quat, opening=0.09, note=""):
+        obs = self.robot.get_obs()
+        now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+        left = now[23:30].tolist()
+        left_open = float(now[15])
+        row = [*map(float, xyz), *map(float, quat), float(opening), *left, left_open]
+        res = self.robot.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(row, dtype=np.float32), video="mp4", note=note)
+        self.calls += 1
+        print("MOVE", note, "done=", res.meta.get("done"), "reason=", res.meta.get("reason"),
+              "plan=", res.meta.get("plan"), "status=", self.robot.status())
+        if res.last:
+            save_obs(res, f"move_{self.calls:02d}")
+        return res
+
+    def approach(self):
+        obs = self.observation("before_approach")
+        now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+        right = now[16:23].tolist()
+        x, y, z = map(float, right[:3])
+        q = right[3:]
+        self.move_right((x, y, max(z + 0.12, 0.97)), q, note="lift above table")
+        self.move_right((SCREW_XY[0], SCREW_XY[1], 0.93), q, note="move over screw")
+        self.move_right((SCREW_XY[0], SCREW_XY[1], 0.85), VERTICAL_DOWN, note="align vertical over screw")
+        obs = self.observation("at_pregrasp")
+        print("APPROACH_COMPLETE", json.dumps(self.robot.status()), "tcp=", obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][16:30])
+
+    def grasp(self):
+        self.move_right((SCREW_XY[0], SCREW_XY[1], 0.778), VERTICAL_DOWN, opening=0.075,
+                        note="lower open gripper around screw")
+        res = self.move_right((SCREW_XY[0], SCREW_XY[1], 0.778), VERTICAL_DOWN, opening=0.0,
+                              note="close gripper on screw")
+        obs = self.observation("after_grasp")
+        print("GRASP_STATE", "opening_m=", obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][62],
+              "tcp=", obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][16:23], "done=", res.meta.get("done"))
+
+    def transfer(self):
+        self.move_right((SCREW_XY[0], SCREW_XY[1], 0.94), VERTICAL_DOWN, opening=0.0,
+                        note="lift screw clear of table")
+        self.move_right((CONTAINER_XY[0], CONTAINER_XY[1], 0.94), VERTICAL_DOWN, opening=0.0,
+                        note="move over container")
+        res = self.move_right((CONTAINER_XY[0], CONTAINER_XY[1], 0.885), VERTICAL_DOWN, opening=0.0,
+                              note="place screw point inside container bounds")
+        if res.meta.get("done"):
+            return
+        # This lower target is inside the container and allows the screw to fall in.
+        self.move_right((CONTAINER_XY[0], CONTAINER_XY[1], 0.855), VERTICAL_DOWN, opening=0.0,
+                        note="lower into container")
+        res = self.move_right((CONTAINER_XY[0], CONTAINER_XY[1], 0.855), VERTICAL_DOWN, opening=0.07,
+                              note="release screw over container")
+        obs = self.observation("after_release")
+        print("TRANSFER_COMPLETE", json.dumps(self.robot.status()), "opening_m=", obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][62])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    phase = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "approach"
+    ctl = Controller()
+    if phase == "approach":
+        ctl.approach()
+    elif phase == "grasp":
+        ctl.grasp()
+    elif phase == "transfer":
+        ctl.transfer()
+    elif phase == "all":
+        ctl.approach()
+        ctl.grasp()
+        ctl.transfer()
+    else:
+        raise SystemExit(f"unknown phase {phase!r}; choose approach, grasp, transfer, all")
*** End Patch";
